literal: Knowing righteousness, those who do not covet and possess wisdom—knowing the proper way, right there, wealth will reach them.
translation: Wealth, knowing the proper way, will go and reach those wise people who, knowing what is righteous, do not covet others' property.
modern: அறத்தை அறிந்து பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பாத அறிவுடையவர்களிடம், செல்வம் தானே வழியறிந்து சென்று சேரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the natural attraction of wealth towards virtuous individuals. Those who possess wisdom understand what is righteous and refrain from coveting others' possessions. To such people, wealth itself will find its way and reach them immediately. The poet personifies wealth as an intelligent entity that actively seeks out and resides with those who practice non-covetousness.
